description: This file contains PowerPC assembly implementations of string manipulation functions such as strcpy, strncpy, strcat, strchr, strcmp, strncmp, strlen, memset, memmove, memcpy, backwards_memcpy, memchr, and memcmp, as well as a cache flush routine. It serves as low-level, architecture-specific code for string operations in a bootloader or kernel context.

methods.name: strcpy
methods.description: Copies a null-terminated string from source to destination.

methods.name: strncpy
methods.description: Copies up to n characters from source to destination, null-terminating if source is shorter than n.

methods.name: strcat
methods.description: Concatenates source string to the end of destination string.

methods.name: strchr
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: strncmp
methods.description: Compares up to n characters of two strings.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string.

methods.name: memset
methods.description: Fills a block of memory with a specified byte.

methods.name: memmove
methods.description: Copies memory from source to destination, handling overlapping regions.

methods.name: memcpy
methods.description: Copies memory from source to destination assuming non-overlapping regions.

methods.name: backwards_memcpy
methods.description: Copies memory backwards, useful for overlapping copies when destination is higher in memory than source.

methods.name: memchr
methods.description: Locates the first occurrence of a byte in a memory block.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes data cache and invalidates instruction cache for a range of addresses.
